event.name: NRF 2027 — Retail's Big Show
event.conference_venue: Jacob K. Javits Convention Center, 429 11th Ave, New York, NY

saturday.label: Saturday reception
saturday.format: Standing reception with food stations and cocktails

sunday.label: Sunday executive dinner
sunday.format: Seated dinner in a private space, opening with cocktails

event.reference: Sunday should feel like Nubeluz at the Ritz-Carlton NoMad — elevated, a sense of occasion, ideally a view — without that price point.

venues.name: Ci Siamo
venues.address: 440 W 33rd St (100 Manhattan West Plaza), New York, NY 10001
venues.booking_note: Address from the external list — not independently verified; the USHG form is the safe fallback.
venues.why: The closest serious room to Javits now that Legacy Records has gone — guests can walk. The private dining room takes 50 seated or 75 standing with an adjacent terrace, so it covers a 50-person reception and a 35-seat dinner from one contact. Danny Meyer's live-fire Italian, and Yelp's number one restaurant in the country for 2026. Published minimums are around $2,500 at lunch and $7,500 at dinner outside December.

venues.name: Zou Zou's
venues.space: Mural Room + Parlour Room (combinable) · Chez Zou for buyouts
venues.address: 385 9th Ave, Manhattan West, New York, NY 10001
venues.why: Mural Room (24 seated / 30 standing) and Parlour Room (18 seated / 20 standing) combine for a group your size, and sister venue Chez Zou upstairs does semi-private and full buyouts for 15–100 — the cleanest single-property answer if you want both nights under one contract minutes from the show floor.

venues.name: Keens Steakhouse
venues.space: Bullmoose Room (30–35 seated) · Lambs Room (up to 80)
venues.proximity: ≈12 min walk / 6 min car from Javits
venues.why: The Bullmoose Room is a 30–35 guest room — an exact fit for the Sunday dinner, with no partition compromise. For Saturday the Lambs Room holds up to 80 (50 minimum). 1885 clay-pipe ceilings and a mutton chop are the most legibly 'New York' thing you can put in front of an international crowd, and it is the closest landmark restaurant to Javits.

venues.name: Le Bernardin
venues.space: Les Salons Bernardin · Le Bernardin Privé
venues.why: Les Salons Bernardin sits one level above the restaurant with its own entrance and movable walls, seating anywhere from 2 to 80 — so a 30–35 exec dinner gets a room sized exactly to it. Eric Ripert's name carries internationally without explanation, which is the whole job on an exec night. Book early; this is the most contested room on the list.

venues.name: Aquavit
venues.why: The Linné Salon is quoted at exactly 30 seated or 50 standing — it hits both of your briefs on the nose, from one room and one contact. Nobel Room scales to 76 seated / 100 standing if the count grows. Two Michelin stars, a Scandinavian register that reads as international rather than American, and a team that runs consular and corporate programs constantly.

venues.name: Manhatta
venues.space: Private Dining Room · Whitman / Bay Rooms
venues.address: 28 Liberty St, 60th Floor, New York, NY 10005
venues.booking_note: Inquiry form at eventsatmanhatta.com — no public events address published.
venues.why: 60 storeys up with the East River, the bridges and the Brooklyn skyline through floor-to-ceiling glass — the view does the hosting for you with an international group. The Private Dining Room is 35 seated / 40 standing (your Sunday number precisely), and the larger rooms scale to 250 standing if Saturday grows. Danny Meyer service standard. F&B minimums start around $2,500.

venues.name: SAGA & Overstory
venues.cuisine: New American tasting — one Michelin star
venues.why: Private rooms on the 62nd floor run 15–40 seated and 30–70 standing, and Overstory one floor up is a cocktail bar wrapped in a 360° terrace — a purpose-built reception room in an Art Deco landmark. Kent Hospitality will quote both nights together. The strongest 'they'll talk about it on the flight home' option that is still a restaurant, not an event hall.

venues.name: COTE Korean Steakhouse
venues.why: Undercote — the subterranean room with its own bar — holds 55, and group dining upstairs runs to 100. Tabletop grills make an exec dinner participatory rather than ceremonial, which is the right energy for night one of a conference. America's first Michelin-starred Korean steakhouse and a reliable crowd-pleaser across nationalities.

venues.name: Gramercy Tavern
venues.booking_note: "Inquire Now" form on gramercytavern.com; Vault Room needs 28 days' notice.
venues.why: Already flagged on your sheet, and it holds up: the semi-private Vault Room seats up to 40 — comfortable at 30–35 rather than maxed out — with the Private Dining Room at 20 and a full buyout to 120. A New York institution that doesn't require anyone to be adventurous, which matters on an executive night.

venues.name: Torrisi
venues.space: Private dining room · semi-private main room · buyout
venues.why: On your sheet already. Confirmed range is 9–45 seated and up to 125 for a cocktail reception, in the Puck Building — so it is one of the few venues here that genuinely covers both nights at your numbers. Major Food Group's events desk is fast to respond.

venues.name: Jungsik
venues.why: From your sheet — and the buyout number is exactly 35, so a Sunday exec dinner takes the entire three-Michelin-star restaurant with no other diners in the room. That total-privacy quality is hard to buy at this level. Note the correct groups address is events@jungsik.com, not the general info@ line on your sheet.

venues.name: Estiatorio Milos — Hudson Yards
venues.space: Terrace (50 seated) · Milos Wine Bar (40) · Porfyra Room
venues.booking_note: Events address not published in the clear — inquire via the Hudson Yards events page or phone; ask them to reply from the direct events address.
venues.why: Walkable from Javits, and the terrace looking over the Hudson and the Vessel seats 50 — the reception number, with a view. The Milos Wine Bar (40) is a natural standing space. Greek seafood is the safest possible common denominator for a mixed international table, and the Midtown sibling scales to 400 if this one is committed.

venues.name: Peak
venues.space: 3,500 sq ft event space · Sky Cellar (18)
venues.address: 30 Hudson Yards, 101st Floor, New York, NY 10001
venues.booking_note: Tao Group event inquiry form on peaknyc.com — no public events address.
venues.why: 101st floor, walking distance from the show floor, and a 3,500 sq ft event space that holds 300 standing — a 50-person reception sits in it comfortably rather than filling it. This is the pure spectacle play for Saturday; guests who have flown in get the skyline on night one. Note the Sky Cellar private room only seats 18, so it is a reception venue here, not a dinner one.

venues.name: Semma
venues.why: On your sheet. The right address for groups is events@semma.nyc (anything over 6), not the general hello@ line. Realistic seated buyout is around 28 with roughly 38–40 for a reception, so 30–35 seated is a stretch worth confirming in writing before you build a night around it — but few rooms in New York are harder to get a table in.

venues.name: Tatiana by Kwame Onwuachi
venues.address: 10 Lincoln Center Plaza, New York, NY 10023
venues.why: On your sheet. The private space sits on the main floor with a movable partition, so it goes semi-private or fully private depending on your count — and it is inside David Geffen Hall at Lincoln Center, which frames the evening as a New York cultural occasion. Confirm the exact partitioned capacity for 30–35; they publish it only on request.

venues.name: Kabawa
venues.why: On your sheet — with one correction: buyout inquiries go to hello@kabawa.com, not events@kabawa.com. The room seats 48 total and they explicitly offer both multi-course seated menus and passed-plate cocktail receptions, so it is one of the few venues that can flip format between your two nights.

venues.name: Aska
venues.space: Main dining room privatized (50) · cellar lounge (16)
venues.why: On your sheet, and the numbers work: the main dining room privatizes for up to 50, the cellar lounge seats 16, and the whole place can be taken. The trade is distance — Williamsburg is a real car ride from Javits, so this is the option if you want the evening to feel like an escape from the conference rather than an extension of it.
venues.booking_note: Listings disagree on whether Aska is currently trading — confirm it is open before building an evening around it.

venues.name: Eleven Madison Park
venues.booking_note: Private Dining & Special Events form on elevenmadisonpark.com/events; info@ is the general guest-relations line.
venues.why: The stretch option for Sunday. Post-renovation the balcony private dining room seats roughly 24 at one table or 27 on rounds — so 30–35 needs confirming, and historically the balcony rooms combined to 50. Worth one email for the name alone, but the menu is entirely plant-based: decide whether that reads as a bold host or a constraint for your exec group before you send.

venues.name: Electric Lemon
venues.address: 33 Hudson Yards, 24th Floor, New York, NY 10001
venues.booking_note: Group enquiry via the site — no events address verified.
venues.why: 24th floor of the Equinox Hotel with Manhattan's largest hotel terrace, ten minutes' walk from the show floor. The private dining room takes 72 seated or 100 standing, so a 40–60 reception sits in it comfortably and a 35-seat dinner has room to breathe. The closest thing on this list to the Nubeluz feeling without leaving Hudson Yards.

venues.name: Boqueria W40th
venues.booking_note: The address on the source list reads events@boqueriannyc.com, which looks like a typo — confirm before sending, or use the site form.
venues.why: The strongest match on the list for the food-station format specifically: giant paellas and Jamón Ibérico carving stations are their standard event set-up, not a special request. The private room only holds 35 standing, so 40–60 means the larger space or a buyout — which takes 175 for a reception.

venues.name: Bad Roman
venues.address: 10 Columbus Circle, 3rd Floor, New York, NY 10019
venues.why: The cleanest numbers on the list for your two briefs: the Piazza Room takes 48 seated or 60 standing, the Lazzeri Room 40 seated or 50 standing, and combined they reach 80 seated / 100 standing. So Saturday at 60 and Sunday at 35 both land inside a single room, in the same venue, on one contract. Central Park views from the Deutsche Bank Center.

venues.name: Quality Italian
venues.why: Two rooms that map onto your two nights: the 57 Room seats 32 — the Sunday number almost exactly — and the Trophy Room takes 60, which is the top of your Saturday range. Same Quality Branded events desk as Zou Zou's and Bad Roman, so all three can be quoted together.

venues.name: Crown Shy
venues.space: Pearl + Cedar Rooms · Nook · full buyout
venues.cuisine: New American — one Michelin star (Kent Hospitality)
venues.why: The Pearl and Cedar rooms together take 50 seated or 80 standing, which covers both briefs without a buyout, and a buyout reaches 125 seated / 300 standing if the count grows. Ground floor of 70 Pine, the same Art Deco tower as SAGA and Overstory — so one enquiry to Kent Hospitality can price all three at once.

venues.name: Temple Court
venues.space: Chapel Street (20) · Kelly Room (70 seated) · Full Cellar
venues.booking_note: Enquiry form on templecourtnyc.com — no events address published.
venues.why: A nine-storey Victorian atrium that does the work Nubeluz does — a room people photograph — at restaurant rather than sky-lounge prices. The Kelly Room seats 70 or holds 80 for a party, and the Full Cellar takes 225 for a cocktail reception, so 40–60 has several options. Tom Colicchio's kitchen.

venues.name: The View
venues.cuisine: New York's only revolving restaurant (Marriott Marquis)
venues.why: The closest match to the Nubeluz brief: a revolving room 48 floors above Times Square, and catering by Union Square Events, whose standard reception format is exactly the mobile bars and food stations you described. Capacities are not published — ask for them alongside the minimum. Hotel pricing rather than sky-lounge pricing.

venues.name: The Grill & The Pool
venues.space: The Salon (15) · Gallery (22) · The Pool · The Grill
venues.why: A landmark room, and the successor to the Four Seasons. The catch is sizing: the Salon takes 15 and the Gallery 22 — both under your Sunday number — while The Pool seats 180 and The Grill holds 350 for a reception, both well over. Ask specifically what they can close off for 35; the answer decides whether this is on the list.

venues.name: The Modern
venues.booking_note: Carried from the external list — capacity and contact not independently verified.
venues.why: Danny Meyer inside MoMA, with the sculpture garden through the glass — a strong Sunday room if the budget stretches. Capacities were not verified; info@ is the general line, so expect to be routed to the events desk.

venues.why: Premium Sunday option on Central Park South. Carried from the source list; capacities not independently verified.

venues.booking_note: Carried from the external list — capacity and contact not independently verified.
venues.why: A steakhouse with several private rooms and a Quality Branded events contact, so it can be quoted alongside Zou Zou's, Bad Roman and Quality Italian. Capacities not independently verified.

venues.booking_note: Carried from the external list — capacity and contact not independently verified.
venues.why: Flagged on the source list as the value option for both nights. Capacities not independently verified — worth an early enquiry if the minimums elsewhere come back high.

venues.why: Listed as a strong capacity match for both briefs. Carried from the source list; capacities and the events route are not independently verified.

venues.booking_note: Carried from the external list — capacity and contact not independently verified.
venues.why: A distinctive downtown room at the end of an alley — character rather than views. Booking is through the private dining page; no events address verified.

venues.why: Carried from the source list as corporate-friendly for both nights. Neither the address nor the capacities were verified — check what and where this is before spending an enquiry on it.
